checks.area: Unknown POST outcome and retry behavior
evidence: delivery.py:132-136 saves the exact request and verification-requested marker before invoking the POST-capable function.
If a verify-submit receipt already exists, the requested theorem/file/hash/explanation must match. The established verify function then reuses the saved submission_id and polls it.
If no submit receipt exists but the marker exists, publish() stops with Reconcile prior POST before retry; it does not automatically POST again.
The established verify function contains one POST and no blind retry path. HTTP/transport/JSON failures propagate while leaving the marker.
checks.limits: An unknown POST result still needs manual/read-only reconciliation before a deliberate recovery; this script safely stops rather than claiming the platform never received it.
